newsitem.title: UK: NWE jet rises with gas oil, supply seen growing.
newsitem.headline: NWE jet rises with gas oil, supply seen growing.

text.p: NWE jet fuel markets were inactive and supply short in the immediate term, but traders saw growing avails by the end of the month.

Prices jumped by over $6 per tonne in line with a recovery in gas oil prices, but a recent weakening of the EU diesel premiums in Europe was expected to have the knock-on effect of increasing jet production, a broker said.
Barges were slightly stronger at Dec IPE gas oil +$34 fob ARA, at parity with cif cargoes.
